title: Making football management feel more immediate
summary: A short introduction to the ideas behind Football Chronicle and why a faster management game can still tell lasting stories.
body:
Football Chronicle began with a simple question: how much can we simplify a management game without losing what makes it compelling?

## Focus on the meaningful moments

Matches, transfers and player development all matter. The goal is to keep their consequences, while shortening the time between the choices that feel important.

## Build a sense of continuity

Player careers, club identities and season histories give the world a personality of its own. Progress is about more than the next result.
